title: In 1958, voters rejected a $15 million reservoir; 68 years later, judge overturns Lake Ringgold permit
summary_full: A recent ruling by a Texas judge has nullified the permit for Wichita Falls' proposed Lake Ringgold reservoir project, which sought to address acute water shortages caused by ongoing drought. This controversial plan raised red flags among ranchers and conservation advocates, as it would affect approximately 16,000 acres of land, threatening to uproot numerous ranching families. The city is now contemplating an appeal and strategizing alternative water solutions.
